open_points.subject: ArtifactPointer lifecycle when its project is deleted whole
open_points.text: Durable, a record of its own naming its project (M01); kept after anonymisation (R0-62).
open_points.question: When the owner deletes an archived project whole, are its ArtifactPointer records deleted with it or retained, and if retained, through which product action can they still be read?
options: Delete every pointer naming the project with the project.
Retain the pointers but make them unreachable because project-based artifact reads return not_found.
Retain the pointers and provide a way to read them after the project is deleted.
open_points.default_guess: Delete every pointer naming the project with the project.
